sloka: सौमित्रेश्चापनिर्घोषं श्रुत्वा प्रतिभयं तदा।विसिष्मिये महातेजा राक्षसेन्द्रात्मजो बली ।। ६.७१.४९ ।।
transliteration: saumitreścāpanirghoṣaṁ śrutvā pratibhayaṁ tadā।visiṣmiye mahātejā rākṣasendrātmajo balī ।। 6.71.49 ।।

translations.english: Then the extraordinarily energetic and powerful son of Rakshasa king was in turn frightened at the sound of Saumithri's bow and was astonished.
